headline: I had to ask the people closest to @lildurk a question… What’s your FAVORITE Lil Durk song
body: I had to ask the people closest to @lildurk a question… What’s your FAVORITE Lil Durk song, and WHY? I asked his father, his uncle, and one of my solid homies to share their favorite Durk songs on Trial 15 Part 2. Coming soon…What’s YOUR favorite Lil Durk song? LilDurk Trial15 OTF. Allegations are not findings of guilt.
